title: Crucified Bonemeal
description: Adds a new item and block to create an infinite bonemeal, made for Builders and Gardeners!
body: This is a mod that adds a new block and item, dubbed: Crucified Bone Block and Crucified Bonemeal. The Crucified Bone Block is the foundation of the mod and leads to the Crucified Bonemeal. It is found in several chests across various structures: - Ancient Cities - Desert Pyramids - Shipwrecks - Jungle Temples - Dungeons - Strongholds - Woodland Mansions - Pillager Outposts Once you obtain 8 Crucified Bone Blocks you can then surround a Skeleton Skull (best found in Ancient Cities) and you will obtain the new Crucified Bonemeal Item. This new Crucified Bonemeal item acts similar to vanilla bonemeal, but it never expires. You can use it infinitely on any block and you will never run out of it. - **Q. Will you ever port to Forge?** - A. No, I no longer support Forge Versions. If you wish to, contact me via the K Studios Development discord server and we can talk about it. - **Q. Backport or forward port?** - A. Maybe if my time allows it, I mod mainly for the versions I play so I likely won't be backporting or forward porting unless I play for that version. - **Q. Why isn't this on CurseForge?** - A. I do not want my mods to be associated with that site or Overwolf.
